For heatmap intensity, we divide the absolute cell value by the largest absolute value the heatmap displays in that column, among the nine models. Zero denotes no discrepancy and one the largest displayed discrepancy; a column of zeros remains zero. This relative shading supports comparisons within each endpoint. It depends on the displayed systems and supplies no cross-test ranking or acceptance threshold. The headings retain domain colours. Unavailable estimates remain unshaded and carry a dash. We draw every model row from the nine-model scorecard. The complete scorecard retains source-level intervals, coverage, and failure statuses beyond these examples.
blocks.zh: 单元格保留端点单位。 与匹配的人类参考文献相比,签名的数值记录方向;其解释取决于终点. 绝对差异和有限度的损失使用自己的非负比尺度。 对于热映射强度,我们将绝对细胞值除以该列中热映射显示的最大绝对值,属于9种模型. 0表示无差异,是显示的最大差异之一;一栏为0,仍为0。 此相对阴影支持在每个端点内进行比较。 它取决于所显示的系统,并且供应没有交叉测试的排名或接受阈值. 标题保留域色 。 无法获得的估计数仍没有阴影,并带有破折号。 我们从九型计分卡上画出每个模型排. 完整的记分卡保留了源层次间隔,覆盖,以及这些例子以外的故障状态.

blocks.en: Appendix C Source-specific administration and scoring
blocks.zh: 附录C 特定来源的管理和评分

blocks.en: This appendix records, for each source, the cohort, the administered instrument with its adaptations, and the scoring rules that Section 4 summarises. Tasks follow the gates of Section 4 , with the source-specific rules below. Request counts are planned requests per model unless we state otherwise; they exclude retries and retain unreached sequence steps.
blocks.zh: 本附录记录每个来源、组别、经管理的文书及其修改,以及第4节概述的评分规则。 任务遵循第4节的大门,下面有特定来源的规则。 除非我们另有说明,请求数是每个模型的计划请求;它们排除了重复和保留未达到的顺序步骤。

blocks.en: C.1 Cohorts, eligibility, and reuse
blocks.zh: C.1 串联、资格和再利用

blocks.en: For most tasks, a practical cap of 512 participants limits inference cost and computation across models, conditions, and repetitions. We selected nine models to represent state-of-the-art proprietary and open-weight systems.
blocks.zh: 对于大多数任务,512名参与者的实际上限限制推论成本和跨模型,条件和重复的计算. 我们选择了9种模型来代表最先进的专有和开放量产系统.

blocks.en: GSS eligibility requires recorded adulthood, a complete mapped profile, a positive source weight, and at least one observed target response; the interpersonal task uses face-to-face and telephone respondents only, giving 276 benchmark people, and the confidence task 664. SAPA includes respondents in recorded age bands from 19 years with adequate recorded English proficiency and complete target batteries. Experimental tasks retain their sources’ eligibility and assignment rules. Twin’s item catalogue exceeds the number the source administered to any one respondent because the source assigned forms at random. SAPA batteries and Jordan experiments share source populations and are one study family each.
blocks.zh: 安全总局的资格要求有记录的成年、完整的映射图、积极的源重以及至少一个观察到的目标反应;人际任务只使用面对面和电话回答,给276个基准人,以及信心任务664。 SAPA包括19岁以上有记录年龄带的答卷人,他们有足够的记录英语熟练程度和完整的目标电池。 实验任务保留其来源的资格和分配规则。 Twin项目目录超过了向任何一个答复者提供的源数,因为源数是随机的。 SAPA电池和约旦的实验共享源量,并且各自是一个研究家族.

blocks.en: GFS uses the public annual-wave file and selects adults GFS observed in both waves in the United States, United Kingdom, and Australia with recorded online administration, 32,245, 3,617, and 2,580 eligible people, from whom each country’s benchmark roster is a hash-ranked sample of 512. GFS collected year-two observations in 2024. Stems and endpoint labels come from the published translation workbooks; we check them across both waves and against the value labels, repeating each group’s lead-in for every isolated item. Language is unavailable in the public records, so these are English-majority cohorts without respondent-level language matching.
blocks.zh: GFS使用公共年波文档,并选择在美国、联合王国和澳大利亚两波中观察到的成人GFS,有记录的在线管理,32,245,3,617人和2,580名合格人员,每个国家的基准名册都是排行榜512的样本。 GFS于2024年收集了第2年的观测数据. 成品和端点标签来自已出版的翻译工作手册;我们通过波浪和值标签来检查它们,重复每个组对每一个孤立项目的引导。 公共记录中没有语言,因此,这些是英语占多数的组群,没有对应的答卷人语言。

blocks.en: The project is company-funded scholarly research. We use GFS under its CC BY-NC instrument licence VanderWeele [2017] and CC BY data licence, ESS under CC BY-NC-SA, FSD3587 and Twin under CC BY 4.0, and NetHealth’s BFI-44 under the instrument’s documented research-use grant. Bainbridge prompts use public-domain IPIP items, and we compute the BFI-2 criteria locally. We use Llama 4 Scout under the Llama 4 Community Licence. Source data and instruments retain their respective reuse conditions.
blocks.zh: 该项目是由公司资助的学术研究。 我们使用GFS的CC BY-NC仪器许可证VanderWeele [2017] 和CC BY数据许可证,ESS的CC BY-NC-SA,FSD3587和Twin的CC BY4.0,以及NetHealth的BFI-44的文献研究用途赠款。 Bainbridge 提示使用公共域IPIP项目,我们在当地计算BFI-2标准. 我们使用Llama 4童子军 根据Llama 4社区许可证。 源数据和仪器保持各自的再利用条件。

blocks.en: C.2 Prompt reconstruction and recorded personas
blocks.zh: C.2 迅速重建和记录人员

blocks.en: We reconstruct templates from Appendix C of Gordon et al. Gordon et al. [2026] with typesetting normalisation, substituting each source’s study dates and question content. We take instrument text from released ballots and questionnaires. GSS uses the fielded category labels and the released 2024 confidence stems with their introduction and the fairness preamble. Bainbridge rows drop the Qualtrics export separator. FSD3587 retains the Finnish battery instruction asking about people in general. ANES 2020 transcript labels are the source gate question that the probe follows, and we resolve candidate names and pronouns. We show Jordan drug-recall choices as labels without archive codes. Cint and Bovitz requests carry each panel’s recorded collection dates. Recorded and L4 conditions share one response-format instruction. We do not reproduce exact live screens, showcard artwork, and interviewer probes, and a fixed order replaces ValueConsistency’s per-person option shuffle, which the source did not record.
blocks.zh: 我们从Gordon等人的附录C重建模板。 戈登等编著. [2026] 具有排版规范化,替代每个来源的研究日期和问题内容. 我们从公布的选票和调查问卷中获取文书文本。 GSS使用放出类别标签,发布的2024年信心随其引入和公平序言而产生. Bainbridge 列放下 Qualtrics 导出分隔符 。 FSD3587 保留芬兰的电池指令,询问一般人的情况。 ANES 2020记录片标签是源门问题,探测器随之而来,我们解决候选名称和代词. 我们把乔丹毒品召回的选择 当作没有档案密码的标签 Cint和Bovitz请求载有每个小组记录的收集日期。 记录条件和L4条件共享一个响应格式指令. 我们不复制精确的现场屏幕、显卡艺术和采访者探测器,而且固定的订单取代了源头没有记录的“价值一致性”个人选项洗牌。

blocks.en: GSS harmonisation gives Hispanic origin priority in the ethnicity mapping, retains party leaners as Independents, and maps settlement categories to the protocol’s urbanicity categories, with a stricter mapping as a sensitivity analysis. External tasks use the recorded-persona form of L3 in a single user message that keeps the instruction to answer as the person. We do not convert age bands to exact ages and omit unavailable fields. We render SAPA age and proficiency codes as readable descriptions. Weather and ValueConsistency are unprofiled.
blocks.zh: GSS协调在种族分布图中给予西班牙裔优先,保留政党倾向者为独立党人,将定居类别划入协议的城市化类别,更严格的绘图作为敏感性分析。 外部任务在单个用户信息中使用L3的录制-人称形式,保持指令作为人回答. 我们不会把年龄带转换成精确的年龄,省略了没有的字段。 我们把SAPA的年龄和熟练程度代码作为可读描述. 天气和价值的连贯性没有被描绘出来。

blocks.en: C.3 Twin free text, distillation, and information comparisons
blocks.zh: C.3 联合国 双自由文本、蒸馏和信息比较

blocks.en: Twin’s three open questions ask respondents who they aspire to be, ought to be, and actually are; all 2,058 source people answered, with a combined median of 117 words. The 512 benchmark people receive six cells, namely demographics alone, demographics with closed-ended history, verbatim descriptions, history with verbatim descriptions, distilled descriptions, and history with distilled descriptions. The demographic and history tasks contain 42 item variants and 24 assigned observations per person. The common information comparison uses the 430 accepted profiles and excludes ten policy self-placement items, because self-descriptions may state political views directly, and retains 32 behavioural item variants with 14 assigned observations per person. The 32 variants are alternative forms of classic judgement problems that the source assigned at random, and we estimate 18 between-person form contrasts (framing, base rate, conjunction, outcome bias, sunk cost, absolute against relative saving, willingness to accept against willingness to pay, Allais, my-side bias, less-is-more, and proportion dominance) with the wording-contrast estimator and read them as EV-3 and IV-4.
blocks.zh: 双胞胎的三个公开问题问答者,他们希望成为谁,应该是谁,而且实际上是谁;所有2 058名来源者都回答,合计中位数为117个字。 512个基准人群得到6个细胞,即仅人口统计,人口统计学有封闭历史,逐字记录,历史有逐字记录,提炼描述,历史有提炼描述. 人口和历史任务包括42项变体和每人24项分配的观察。 共同信息比较使用430个被接受的剖面图,不包括10个政策自我定位项目,因为自我描述可能直接表达政治观点,并保留32个行为项目变体,每人14个指定观察. 32变体是来源随机分配的经典判断问题的另类形式,我们估计人与人之间的对比度为18(香,基率,结合,结果偏差,沉积成本,绝对反对相对节约,愿意接受对支付的意愿,Allais,我的侧偏差,少一点,比例占优势),其措辞上是前后矛盾的判断,并读作EV-3和IV-4.

blocks.en: Distillation uses one call per person to gpt-5.4-2026-03-05 at temperature 0.2 with reasoning disabled, JSON output, and a 1,024-token cap, returning the protocol’s seven fields (values summary, moral foundations, decision style, institutional trust, political engagement, key concerns, and consumer orientation). We use each trait field only when the participant explicitly names its subject and it then consists of exact quotations; otherwise it holds the string “Not stated in the source responses.” We do not list aspirations and obligations as concerns unless the participant called them one, and the narrative attributes each statement to its question. A second-model audit by claude-opus-5 , which we conduct within our study, compares every statement with the source answers, and mechanical exact-quote and target-text checks follow; we exclude profiles that fail without editing, and use the same surviving people and person-item mask for verbatim and distilled comparisons. The shared profile serves every model and repetition. We cap profiles at 16,000 UTF-8 bytes. The profile audit retained 430 of 512 unedited profiles (84.0 percent), yielding 216,720 collected answers across nine models and two repetitions. The audit accepted 453 profiles; 23 required field resets and we excluded them from the unedited cohort. Audit failures include unsupported attributions or quotations; the final cohort also excludes profiles requiring repair.
blocks.zh: Distillation在0.2温度下使用每人1通电话gpt-5.4-2026-03-05, 其推理、JSON输出和1 024个托肯封顶被禁用, 我们只当参与者明确指定其对象,然后由确切的引文组成时,才使用每个特征字段;否则,该字串为“来源答复中未说明”。 我们不把愿望和义务列为关注事项,除非与会者称之为愿望和义务,而且说明将每一项声明都归入问题。 由Claude-opus-5进行的第二模式审计,在我们的研究中,将每个陈述与源答案进行比较,然后进行机械精确的引用和目标文字检查;我们排除了不经过编辑而失败的剖面图,并使用同样的幸存者和人物面具进行逐字记录和提炼比较。 共享简介服务于每一个模型和重复. 我们以16000 UTF-8 字节封顶 概况审计保留了512份未经编辑的概况中的430份(84.0%),在9种模式和2份重复中收集了216 720份答复。 审计接受了453份简介;需要23份外地资料,我们把它们排除在未经编辑的组别之外。 审计失败包括无根据的归属或报价;最后一组不包括需要修复的概况。

blocks.en: Within-source information comparisons use paired changes in bounded prediction loss that we average within person, with 500 participant bootstrap draws. Negative changes indicate improved prediction in the second condition. Each comparison requires at least thirty people with a paired difference; item coverage does not determine whether we report it. Each person’s difference averages the items models answered validly in both rungs, and we report the lowest item coverage beside every comparison in the ladder file. The minimum across all 270 comparisons is 187 of 216, or 0.866, on a Grok lottery item. All 270 comparisons are estimable, comprising 180 hosted and thirty for each local model. They describe jointly valid answers and can use different item sets; they do not recover outcomes for missing answers. The 82 excluded people form a separate sensitivity check. All twelve of Mistral’s individual common-cohort cells also meet the coverage rule.
blocks.zh: 内源信息比较使用我们平均在人体内的极限预测损失的配对变化,有500名参与者的靴子画。 负变化表明第二个条件的预测有所改善。 每一次比较至少需要30人,有对比差异;项目覆盖范围不能决定我们是否报告. 每个人的差别都平均显示两种模式都有效回答, 所有270个比较中的最低数字是Grok彩票项目216的187个或0.866个。 所有270项比较都值得评价,其中180项为主机,30项为每个当地模式。 它们描述了联合有效的答案,并且可以使用不同的项目集;它们不会对缺失的答案恢复结果. 82名被排除在外的人组成了单独的敏感性检查. Mistral的12个普通细胞都符合覆盖规则。

blocks.en: C.4 ANES 2020 verbatims and ANES 2024 order
blocks.zh: C.4 ANES 2020逐字记录和ANES 2024顺序

blocks.en: The February 2022 ANES 2020 release links 8,280 people to eight pre-election redacted text sheets; the three post-election most-important-problem sheets match 7,526. Requiring 100 pre-election words, English administration, a completed post wave, and no identity concern leaves 1,982 eligible people, from whom we hash-select 512 benchmark people. Three conditions compare recorded demographics, demographics with pre-election party and candidate likes and dislikes, and the same text with later problem statements. We retain original strings, and topic patterns we apply to all text exclude potentially disclosed targets in every condition, leaving 1,205 thermometer observations (Jews 432, police 230, transgender people 453, scientists 90). Thermometers take one integer from 0 to 100 with the anchor paragraph that we adapt from person to group. The source measures residence post-election, and the problem statements follow the thermometer battery, so the later conditions are reconstructions. A separate order task replays the attention and trust items for 5,921 benchmark English web respondents (3,021 forward, 2,900 reverse) using pre-election demographics.
blocks.zh: 2022年2月的ANES 2020发布会链接到8,280人与8个选举前编辑的文字表;3个选举后最重要的问题表匹配7,526人. 需要100个选举前的单词,英语管理,一个已完成的后浪,没有身份考虑,留下1,982个符合条件的人,我们从他们中选出了512个基准人. 三个条件将记录的人口统计,人口统计与选举前的政党和候选人喜欢和不喜欢,以及同一文本与后来的问题陈述进行比较. 我们保留了原有的字符串,而且我们适用于所有文本的专题模式排除了每个条件中可能披露的目标,留下了1,205个温度计观测(Juews 432,Police 230,变性人453,科学家90). 温度计的整数从0到100, 加上我们从人到组的调适段。 来源衡量选后居住地,问题陈述跟随温度计电池,所以后期条件为重建. 单项订单任务使用预选人口统计重现了5,921个基准英语网页受访者(3,021向前,2,900反)的注意力和信任项目.

blocks.en: ANES 2024 supplies the first substantive question, attention to government and politics, for 2,041 English fresh-web respondents (1,067 forward, 974 reverse); 1,630 form the benchmark. The model receives the stem and labels in the assigned order. We compare reverse-minus-forward category and cumulative probabilities with 500 paired participant bootstraps within arm. Weighted sensitivity uses the full-sample weight with Taylor linearisation over the design variables.
blocks.zh: ANES 2024为2,041名英语新网答卷人(向前1,067,倒数974)提供了第一个实质性问题,即对政府和政治的关注;1,630人构成了基准. 模型在指定顺序中接收干和标签. 我们比较了反向偏移的类别和累积概率与手臂内500双参赛靴。 重量敏感度使用泰勒在设计变量上线性化的全样本重量.

blocks.en: C.5 Repeatability, retest, and logical coherence (IV-1, IV-2)
blocks.zh: C.5 可重复性、再测试和逻辑一致性(IV-1、IV-2)

blocks.en: Technical repeatability compares the first and last generation for the same observation, with agreement and Cohen’s kappa for categorical items and range-normalised differences for numerical ones. Twin compares earlier human answers with wave-four answers and model answers with the same wave-four records; human persistence is a reference. Bainbridge supplies duplicate-item agreement.
blocks.zh: 技术可重复性将相同观察的第一代和最后一代进行比较,同意和科恩的kappa对绝对项目进行比较,对数字项目进行范围规范差异比较。 Twin将早期的人类答案与波四解答和模型解答与相同的波四解答记录进行比较;人类的持久性是一种参考. 班布里奇提供重复项目协议。

blocks.en: Weather coherence uses 27 linear probability constraints covering complements, conjunctions, disjunctions, inclusion-exclusion, and conditional complements with a one-percentage-point tolerance, reporting violation rates, residual magnitudes, violation-pattern distance, and the share of people with any violation on matched complete blocks. Keyed-opposite pairs in Bainbridge, NetHealth, and SAPA, which we define from item wording, give contradiction rates. Graded consensus contributes the share of people whose stated belief falls as consensus rises and the share of decreasing adjacent steps.
blocks.zh: 天气一致性使用27个线性概率限制,包括补充、结合、分离、包容-排斥,以及有条件的补充,以一个百分点的容忍度、报告违规率、剩余数量、违规模式距离以及任何违规者在相应完整区块上的份额。 我们从项目措辞中定义的Bainbridge、NetHealth和SAPA的键对对子给出了矛盾率。 评级的共识有助于那些在共识上升和相邻步骤减少的情况下表达信仰的人的份额。

blocks.en: C.6 Paraphrases and method effects (IV-3, IV-4)
blocks.zh: C.6 用语和方法效果(IV-3、IV-4)

blocks.en: ValueConsistency supplies 81 attention-passing participants, each answering a five-question battery on one of 27 topics; 64 are in the benchmark. We present the battery in source order and models answer it as a JSON array. A study-specific script applies a fixed list of wording exclusions, set before model results, retaining 89 of 108 original-paraphrase pairs for primary scoring. The exclusions target changes in scope or strength, such as “everyone” in place of “citizens” or “necessary” in place of “should”. This is a rule-based screen, not an independent human equivalence rating. We display all questions and score all pairs in a sensitivity analysis. We weight agreement, kappa, and transition distance equally over people and pairs within person. Near-paraphrase pairs in Bainbridge, NetHealth, and SAPA, and ESS method pairs, supply further IV-3 estimates.
blocks.zh: 价值一致性为81名经过关注的参与者提供了服务,每个参与者就27个专题之一回答5个问题电池;64个在基准中。 我们按源头排列电池 模型作为JSON阵列来回答 特定研究的脚本采用固定的措辞排除列表,设定在模型结果之前,保留了108个原配对中的89个,用于初等评分. 排除的目的是改变范围或力度,例如“人人”代替“公民”或“必要”代替“应”。 这是一个基于规则的屏幕,而不是独立的人类等价评级. 我们在灵敏度分析中显示所有的问题和得分。 我们的重量一致,Kappa, 和过渡距离 相等于人和人的对。 Bainbridge、NetHealth和SAPA的近参数对以及ESS方法对,提供了进一步的IV-3估计。

blocks.en: ESS Round 7 Great Britain administers 13 main and nine assigned supplementary questions in source order, with the current question, its response card where one exists, and the persona’s preceding generated answers. Of 2,264 raw records, 2,203 adults with known regional wording remain (form A 1,150, form B 1,053); we hash-select 512 benchmark people (276 form A, 236 form B), twenty of them with “the UK” wording. Fifteen card images preserve source orientation, numbers, and labels. We compare paired response transitions, rank associations, and relative category position, stratifying form contrasts by assigned form; 11,264 planned requests per model. Unreached questions stay in coverage denominators. We retain the original request specification and count unreached steps as missing when a provider limit stops a sequence. We report completion and stopping reasons in the sequence-completion summary . The common parser accepts displayed codes with matching labels in either order, punctuation, and wrapper markup. The parsing and retry policy below applies to every model.
blocks.zh: 斯洛文尼亚就业服务局 第7轮大不列颠按源头顺序管理13个主要问题和9个指定补充问题,包括当前问题、存在答复卡的地方以及个人先前的答案。 在2 264份原始记录中,仍有2 203名成年人拥有已知的区域措辞(表格A 1 150,表格B 1 053);我们选了512名基准人(表格A276,表格B236),其中20人使用“联合王国”的措辞。 15张卡片图像保留源方向,数字,和标签. 我们比较了组合式反应过渡、等级联系和相对类别位置,按指定格式对表格进行了对比;每个模式有11 264项计划请求。 无法触及的问题仍停留在覆盖分母中。 我们保留原先的要求规格,当一个提供者限制一个序列时,将未到达的步骤算作缺失. 我们报告完成和停止原因 顺序完成摘要。 常见的解析器接受显示的代码, 并按任一顺序匹配标签, punctuation, 和 mainper 标记 。 下面的解析和重试政策适用于每一个模型.

blocks.en: FSD3587 supplies 1,600 Finnish adults with 3,200 argument-validity ratings on a 0 to 10 scale; 1,280 are in the benchmark. Twenty-four pairwise source-identity contrasts hold argument and topic fixed. We use source Finnish text within the recorded-persona wrapper.
blocks.zh: FSD3587用品 1,600名芬兰成年人在0至10个尺度上获得3,200个辩证无效评级;有1,280个在基准中。 24对偶的源识别对比 持有参数和主题固定。 我们使用源芬兰文本 在录制人包装。

blocks.en: Jordan’s block-order sequence preserves 4,287 participants and 81,456 questionnaire pages with randomised block order, repeated items, recall questions, and distractor batteries. We select 512 benchmark participants (256 per ordering procedure), one generation per model, 9,709 planned requests per model, and scores six post-response category contrasts and six pre-post change contrasts with 500 paired draws within procedure.
blocks.zh: 约旦的区块顺序保留了4,287名参与者和81,456个问题单页,并附有随机的区块顺序、重复的项目、召回问题和分散注意力的电池。 我们选择了512个基准参与者(每个订购程序256个),每个模式一代,每个模式9 709个计划请求,并对6个答复后类别对比和6个员额前变化对比进行评分,其中500个是程序内对接的抽图。

blocks.en: C.7 Experimental contrasts (EV-3, IV-4)
blocks.zh: C.7 实验对比(EV-3,IV-4)

blocks.en: For each contrast we estimate the difference in mean scored response between assigned treatment and control for human and synthetic samples on the same participants and compare it through signed and absolute error, with participant bootstrap within arm. Ordered outcomes use fixed score mappings; the nominal affirmative-action outcome uses favour probability. Acquiescence analyses reverse negative propositions to a common endorsement direction, scoring “Not sure” 0.5, and separate contrasts measure uncertainty-response incidence where that option is available.
blocks.zh: 对于每个对比,我们估计在同一参与者上人类和合成样品的指定处理和控制之间的平均分数反应的差别,并通过签名和绝对错误与臂内的参与者靴子进行比较。 定级结果使用固定分数图;名义上的平权行动结果使用偏好概率. 默认分析将负面提议反向一个共同的认可方向,将“不确定”评分为0.5,并在有这种选择的情况下单独对照衡量不确定性-反应发生率。

blocks.en: Both acquiescence sources use split forms and have limited within-item demographic support for EV-2. Bovitz has 512 participants, but each item has only 5 to 41 human respondents within an age or education group. No group meets the required 50 human and matched respondents. Cint yields an EV-2 estimate because just one of 400 item-group combinations reaches this floor. The family-level count therefore records an estimate with narrow support. Both sources are underpowered for subgroup fidelity and provide the acquiescence contrasts for which their authors designed them under EV-3 and IV-4.
blocks.zh: 这两种默认来源都使用分裂形式,对EV-2的人口统计支持有限。 博维茨有512名参与者,但每个项目在一个年龄或教育群体内只有5至41名人类受访者. 任何团体都不符合要求的50人和匹配的答卷人。 Cint得出EV-2估计值,因为400个项组组合中只有一个到达这个楼层. 因此,家庭一级的统计记录了一种得到有限支持的估计。 这两种来源在分组忠诚方面都力量不足,并提供了作者根据EV-3和IV-4设计的默认对比。

blocks.en: Jordan modules retain the source’s post-only restriction. Albertson and Jessee uses the question-first subgroup and infers assignment from the administered outcome, as in the source. We reproduce stimuli in fresh requests without the preceding survey blocks.
blocks.zh: Jordan的模块保留了来源后的限制。 Albertson和Jessee使用第一问题分组,并推断管理下的结果,如来源。 我们用新的要求来刺激我们,而不需要前面的勘测区块。

blocks.en: Misaligned Moderation Experiment 1 reproduces 300 participants under the authors’ exclusions; 234 are in the benchmark. Each person sees three topics that the source counterbalanced across all-posts, plausible-removal, and implausible-removal conditions with the nine original post images that we encode losslessly. Models generate seven interest and three truth judgements sequentially. Truth uses the six source positions and belief is seven minus the position. Contrasts compare each removal condition with all posts and the two removal conditions with each other, within person and we average them over the counterbalance, with 500 paired draws within allocation cell; 2,340 planned requests per model.
blocks.zh: 偏差温和实验1复制了300名作者被排除在外的参与者;234人已进入基准。 每个人看到三个话题, 源 校对在所有的帖子, 可信的删除, 和不可信的删除条件 与九原始的帖子图像 我们编码 丢失。 模型依次产生7个兴趣和3个真理判断. 真理用6个源位,信仰是7减去位置. 将每个撤职条件与所有职位和两个撤职条件进行对比,在个人内部,我们平均比对平衡,分配单元内有500对抽奖;每个模式有2 340项计划请求。

blocks.en: Orchinik et al. supplies a five-slider question at 50, 75, 90, 97, and 99 percent hypothetical consensus. The 847 control-group people of the 2024 journal sample yield 686 benchmark people. All five rows appear together in ascending order and one request returns five integers on the 0 to 100 scale. We compare adjacent changes, the 50-to-99 change, and the within-person slope, with curve error and the decrease shares as secondary summaries; 686 planned requests per model.
blocks.zh: Orchinik等人以50、75、90、97和99%的假设共识提出了一个五滑问题。 2024年期刊样本的847名控制类人群获得686名基准人群. 所有5行都以上升顺序一起出现,一个请求返回0到100比例的5个整数. 我们比较了相邻的变化,50-99的变化,以及人内坡度,曲线误差和减少的股份作为次要摘要;每个模型计划请求686项.

blocks.en: Pew’s 2017 Western Europe survey assigned 5,840 respondents in France, Germany, and the United Kingdom to ideology scales that the survey numbered 0 to 6 or 1 to 7; the benchmark holds 1,439, 1,747, and 1,460. Profiles contain age, gender, education, and country. We shift displayed 1 to 7 answers to common positions 0 to 6. We compare arm distributions, normalised mean position, midpoint and endpoint mass, and the seven-position effect vector, the half- L 1 L_{1} norm of the difference in effect vectors giving the distributional effect error. Humans could volunteer nonresponse where models choose a substantive integer, so effect comparisons condition on substantive human answers.
blocks.zh: 皮尤2017年西欧调查向法国,德国,英国的5,840名受访者分配了该调查为0-6或1-7的意识形态尺度;基准为1,439,1,747,1,460. 概况包括年龄、性别、教育和国家。 我们向共同立场显示1至7个答案 0至6个。 我们比较臂分布, 正常的平均位置, 中点和端点质量, 和七位效应向量, 半L 1 L_{1} 的规范 效果差的向量, 给出分布效应错误 。 在模型选择实质性整数时,人类可以自愿不响应,从而对实质性人类答案产生比较条件.

blocks.en: C.8 Distributions, relationships, and subgroups (EV-1, EV-2, CV-1)
blocks.zh: C.8 分配、关系和分组(EV-1、EV-2、CV-1)

blocks.en: Categorical marginals use total variation distance, GSS adding Jensen-Shannon distance, frequency RMSE, frequency correlation, and plurality agreement. Numerical marginals use range-normalised Wasserstein distance and signed dispersion difference. Individual loss is disagreement for categories and range-normalised absolute error for numbers, which we average within person first. GSS human sampling references use 2,000 pairs of independent bootstrap samples at each item’s observed size.
blocks.zh: 分类边缘使用总变异距离,GSS增加Jensen-Shannon距离,频率RMSE,频率相关性,以及多元协议. 数值边际使用范围正常的瓦瑟斯坦距离和签名的散射差. 个人损失是分类上的分歧,是数字中范围正常的绝对错误,这是我们个人内部的平均值。 安全总局的人类取样参考材料使用2 000双独立靴子样本,按每个物品的观测大小。

blocks.en: Item relationships use polychoric correlations for ordered GSS items, Cramér’s V V for nominal items, and Spearman correlations for external ordinal or numerical pairs, on the first trial only, requiring 30 matched people with variation on both sides. Convergent-minus-discriminant Pearson correlation gaps for HTOPS and GFS compare within-construct with between-construct item correlations. Each summary retains its full specified pair family in the human data, model data, and every bootstrap draw. Undefined required correlations make the summary unavailable. We require 90 percent complete model coverage among humans with complete item data and at least 95 percent finite bootstrap draws. Subgroups use recorded demographic categories with at least 50 matched people, GSS additionally requiring 100 respondents and an effective size of 50, and compare conditional distributions through total variation and normalised Wasserstein distance together with the spread of group means.
blocks.zh: 物品关系对订购的GSS物品使用多功能关系,Cramér的V V对标称项目,以及Spearman对外部正弦或数值对的关联,在第一次试验时只需要30个配对的人,双方都有变化. HTOPS和GFS的趋同-最小差异的皮尔逊关联性差距与构件间关联性进行比较. 每份摘要都保留了人类数据、模型数据以及每张靴子图画中的全部指定对子家族。 未定义的关联性使得摘要无法使用. 我们需要90%的模型覆盖 在人类中 完整的项目数据 和至少95%的有限拖拉。 分组使用记录的人口类别,至少有50名对应人员,一般安全局还需要100名答卷人,实际人数为50人,并通过总差异和正常的瓦塞斯坦距离与群体手段的传播来比较有条件的分布。

blocks.en: Population coverage is specific to the endpoint. A family we count as yielding an estimate can have eligible support for only one item-group combination. Interpret subgroup results alongside their human and matched counts, uncertainty, and excluded combinations. These eligibility rules govern estimation; a group lacking support retains an unresolved validity claim. The present analysis does not provide every diagnostic within every intersection or a general within-group calibration procedure.
blocks.zh: 人口覆盖率是具体针对终点的。 我们算得出一个估计数的家庭,只能得到一个项目组组合的合格支持。 分组结果与人为和对应的计数、不确定性和排除的组合一并解释。 这些资格规则适用于估算;一个缺乏支持的群体保留了未决的有效性索赔。 本分析并不提供每个交叉点内的每一个诊断,也不提供一般的组内校准程序.

blocks.en: C.9 Traits, criteria, and factor structure (CV-1 to CV-3, EV-4)
blocks.zh: C.9 特性、标准和因数结构(CV-1至CV-3、EV-4)

blocks.en: For the SAPA facets item “Tell the truth”, Gemma requested a phrase to rate in 478 of 512 responses, and DeepSeek declined 39 times. We retain the item as we administered it. Gemma’s facets cells have no estimate; its Big Five cells do.
blocks.zh: 对于SAPA的“说实话”这一项,Gemma要求在512份答复中,有478份答复,DeepSeek下降39次。 我们保留了我们管理的项目。 Gemma的侧面细胞没有估计值;它的五大细胞有。

blocks.en: SAPA uses published keys for the twenty-item Big Five and three three-item facets (well-being, sensation seeking, and honesty) on a six-point scale; NetHealth the BFI-44 and Bainbridge the IPIP Big Five on five-point scales. We score reverse-keyed items as lower plus upper minus response, and normalise trait-score error by item count times response span. We compare scale means, Cronbach’s alpha, scale correlations, and within-trait against between-trait item associations with 500 paired draws, retaining negative alpha and reranking ties within draws.
blocks.zh: SAPA对二十项大五和三个三项目(福祉、求感和诚实)使用已公布的键,分六分;Nethealth the BFI-44和Bainbridge,分五分。 我们把反键项目评分为下加上减响应,按项目计数时间间隔将特异性分数错误正常化. 我们比较了比例法,Cronbach的alpha,比例法关系,以及两岸之间有500对图纸的两岸关系,保留了负的alpha,并在图纸中重新排列关系。

blocks.en: NetHealth links four BFI-44 administrations (719, 415, 317, and 192 respondents in waves 1, 2, 6, and 8) to course grades and wearable measures. Sensor criteria average days 1 to 30 after the survey with at least 14 valid days and 80 percent device compliance; grade criteria average all available letter-graded courses with equal course weights and require at least three courses. Bainbridge’s three samples (253, 398, and 388 adults) supply IPIP targets and independently completed BFI-2 domain means as criteria, with 117, 120, and 120 keyed items. GFS supplies year-two prediction against the same person’s observed year-one answer and the published six domain, ten-item, and twelve-item composites. We compare human and model trait-criterion Spearman correlations on the same people with paired bootstrap intervals; we report constant model traits as failures.
blocks.zh: NetHealth将4个BFI-44管理机构(719、415、317和192个第1、第2、第6和第8阶段的答复者)与课程等级和可穿戴措施联系起来。 传感器标准在调查后平均1至30天,至少14天有效,80%的设备符合标准;年级标准平均为所有可用的书信级课程,课程权重相同,至少需要3个课程。 Bainbridge的三个样本(253,398和388个成年人)提供IPIP目标,独立完成的BFI-2域名作为标准,有117,120和120个密钥项目. GFS提供对同一人观测到的第一年答案的第二年预测以及公布的六个领域、十项和十二项复合材料。 我们比较了人类和模型特征-标准 Spearman的关联性, 相同的人有配对的靴子间隔; 我们把恒定的模型特征报告为失败。

blocks.en: Criterion provenance determines the scope of interpretation. Independently completed personality scales remain self-report criteria; wearable records and recorded grades provide different forms of external evidence. A trait-criterion correlation measures an association and supplies no direct estimate of person-level predictive calibration. Likewise, performance on hypothetical choices, incentivised decisions, and field behaviour should retain separate interpretations. The current scorecard does not estimate a common intention–behaviour gap or establish transfer from laboratory choices to field outcomes. Human–model ordinal invariance addresses measurement comparability between those samples; subgroup invariance requires its own supported fit.
blocks.zh: 标准来源决定了解释的范围. 独立完成的人格表仍然是自我报告标准;可穿戴的记录和记录的等级提供了不同形式的外部证据. 特征-标准相关性衡量一个关联,不直接估计人的预测校准。 同样,在假设选择、激励性决定和实地行为方面的业绩应保留单独的解释。 目前的记分卡没有估计共同的意图-行为差距,也没有确定从实验室选择转移到实地成果。 人类模式的平面变化涉及这些样本之间的测量可比性;分组变化需要其自身支持的适应性。

blocks.en: Factor structures use the published simple structures with correlated factors. For the SAPA, NetHealth, Bainbridge, and HTOPS exploratory comparisons, we fit a fixed human reference on people with complete benchmark battery data. We compare each synthetic sample with this reference on loadings, congruence, factor correlations, and omega. Demographic-slope comparisons use matched people and the same fixed reference transformation. Each output records the reference sample size and the model-specific complete-case count. For DeepSeek on SAPA facets, these counts are 512 and 473, respectively. These ULS comparisons use a continuous approximation and require at least 100 complete matched people and 90 percent complete model coverage among humans with complete battery data. ULS fits use Pearson correlations and require optimiser convergence, off-diagonal correlation RMSE at most 0.10, and no loading above 0.994. Loadings range from 0.001 to 0.995, and optimisation permits at most 1,000 function evaluations. We report poor human reference fits with their indices and label partial or poor model fits. Demographic slopes can remain available when a loading fit fails, so family-level EV-4 coverage can reflect only part of the diagnostic set.
blocks.zh: 因素结构使用公布的具有相关因素的简单结构. 对于SAPA、NetHealth、Bainbridge和HTOPS的探索性比较,我们对拥有完整基准电池数据的人,采用了固定的人类参考。 我们把每个合成样本 与这个关于装载,一致,因子关联, 和omega的参考。 人口分布比较的使用情况与人相称,也与固定参考变化相同。 每个输出都记录参考样本大小和模型专用的完整案例计数. 关于SAPA方面的DeepSeek, 这些数字分别为512和473。 这些ULS比较使用连续近似法,需要至少100个完全匹配的人,以及90%的完整模型覆盖到拥有完整电池数据的人类. ULS适配使用皮尔逊相关器,需要Opimiser聚合器,离对角相关器RMSE最多0.10,不装载超过0.994. 装载量在0.001至0.995之间,优化最多可进行1 000项功能评价。 我们报告说,人类的参考不足与其指数相符,并标出部分或差的模式。 人口坡度在装填失败时仍可使用,因此家庭级的EV-4覆盖只能反映部分诊断集.

blocks.en: Ordinal measurement invariance requires at least 200 people and fits configural, threshold, loading, and intercept models to joint human and synthetic data with WLSMV estimation and theta parameterisation in lavaan , Wu-Estabrook identification Wu and Estabrook [2016] , robust nested comparisons, and 500 paired bootstrap refits of the separate human and model factor models with seed 9142026. These refits quantify uncertainty in correlation and reliability diagnostics. Nested joint invariance comparisons use robust asymptotic inference; ESS category omissions prevent that joint sequence here. Reference fit requires scaled CFI at least 0.90, RMSEA and SRMR at most 0.08; we report a reference outside these bounds with its indices and flag it. We report a synthetic sample whose responses do not span the scale’s categories as a category collapse. We fit the ESS structure reference on 397 development participants over the nine 0 to 10 items. All nine models omit response categories. Humans use all eleven immigration response categories, whereas OpenAI uses only 6 to 10; on the white-immigrants item, model responses concentrate on 0 to 4. The 478 humans with complete battery data also omit category 9 on that item. This omission persists in each model’s matched sample and limits the full-category joint fit. The scorer reports category collapse when model categories are absent and leaves categories unmerged. This failure to reproduce scale use contributes evidence to CV-1 and EV-4.
blocks.zh: 常态测量偏差至少需要200人,并符合配置,阈值,加载,拦截模型与WLSMV估算和熔岩中的Theta参数化结合的人类和合成数据. Wu-Estabrook识别 Wu和Estabrook [2016],坚固的巢状比较,500对对双靴子重新组合了单独的人类和模型因子模型,种子9142026. 这些调整可以量化相关性和可靠性诊断中的不确定性。 嵌入式联合偏差比较使用强烈的不对称推论;ESS分类的遗漏在此防止了联合序列. 参考适用要求至少将参考指数调整为0.90、RMSEA和SRMR,最多为0.08;我们报告在这些界限外的参考指数,并标出其标志。 我们报告一个合成的样本,其反应没有作为类别崩溃而跨越比额表的类别。 在9个0至10个项目中,我们符合397名发展参与者的ESS结构参考。 所有9种模型都省略了响应类别. 人类使用所有11个移民响应类别,而OpenAI只使用6至10个;在白人移民项目上,模型响应集中于0至4个. 拥有完整电池数据的478名人类也省略了该项目的第9类. 在每个模型的匹配样本中,这种遗漏持续存在,并限制了整个类别的联合吻合。 计分员报告在模型分类缺失时分类崩溃,而分类则未合并. 未能复制规模使用法有助于证明CV-1和EV-4。

blocks.en: C.10 2026 cross-sections (HTOPS)
blocks.zh: C.10 2026 截面(HTOPS)

blocks.en: The March, May, and July 2026 HTOPS files contain 12,521, 12,636, and 12,755 respondents from whom HTOPS collected responses 13 to 30 March, 29 April to 18 May, and 15 July to 3 August 2026. Each cross-section yields 512 benchmark people. Personas contain recorded unallocated demographics and broad geography; we omit imputed fields and the age boundary codes. We administer fifteen items in March and May and nineteen in July individually with their shared preambles, life satisfaction on the displayed 0 to 10 scale. Person-weight sensitivity uses the full weight and all 80 successive-difference replicates with the 4 / 80 4/80 variance coefficient and 95 percent normal intervals.
blocks.zh: 2026年3月,5月,7月的HTOPS文档中包含12,521,12,636和12,755位被调查者,HTOPS从他们那里收集了答复13至30,4月29至5月18日,以及2026年7月15日至8月3日. 每个横截面可产生512人的基准。 人有记录的未分配人口和广泛的地理;我们省略了估算的字段和年龄界限代码。 我们在3月和5月管理了15件物品,在7月管理了19件物品,它们有共同的序言,在0至10的尺度上满足了生活。 人-体重敏感度使用全重,所有80个连续偏差以4 / 80 4/80差异系数和95%的正常间隔复制.

blocks.en: C.11 Baselines and missing outputs
blocks.zh: C.11 基线和缺失的产出

blocks.en: GSS baselines are development-sample empirical distributions, demographic multinomial regression, and nearest-donor answer vectors; overlapping development evaluations use five-fold participant cross-fitting. As in the statistical-control comparisons of Lukauskas and Šarkauskaitė Lukauskas and Šarkauskaitė [2026] , we distinguish independent item sampling from sampling that approximates dependence. We fit the Gaussian rank copula on at least 30 complete development people with empirical marginals, midrank Gaussian scores, and fixed 0.05 identity shrinkage, and it draws one joint vector per held-out person with a fixed seed; the independent-marginal control draws from the same marginals. We report invalid and missing model outputs beside conditional scores, with worst-case bounds for bounded losses. Weighted GSS sensitivities use a Rao-Wu rescaled bootstrap over source strata and clusters Rao and Wu [1988] .

ESS method pairs change several administration features, so we interpret them as method comparisons.

blocks.en: We developed additional parsing rules from observed response formats and applied the final rules to every model. The parser maps responses to a unique permitted option using response text, option labels, and specified normalisations, including documented source-spelling aliases; it does not use the human target answer. Permitted normalisations cover wrappers, markers, case, and punctuation, a prefix that identifies exactly one option, or a whole option label within a longer reply with a negation guard and no mention of a second option. The source-spelling aliases map the exact corrected forms of “miillion” and “probablity” to the source’s option labels; they do not permit general typo correction or paraphrases. Block-order parsing accepts option labels or integer codes within matrix objects or arrays, brace sets, and string-valued “null”. Consensus parsing accepts one prose preamble before an otherwise valid response array. For example, the parser accepts “My answer is strongly agree” when it identifies only that option, but rejects “Agree” when both “Agree a little” and “Agree strongly” remain possible. These rules identify a permitted label; they do not guarantee that every longer reply expresses an unambiguous intention. We preserve raw outputs, record each normalisation, and retain invalid and missing responses in coverage counts.
blocks.zh: 我们从观测到的响应格式中制定了额外的解析规则,并将最终规则应用于每个模型. 解析器使用响应文本,选项标签,以及指定的常态化,包括有文献记载的源拼别名,对唯一允许选项的响应进行映射;它不使用人类目标答案. 允许的常态化覆盖包装、标记、大小写和标点,一个前缀,可以准确识别一个选项,或者在较长的回复中包含一个带有否定的守护符且未提及第二个选项的整个选项标签。 来源的别名将 " miillion " 和 " probabblity " 的确切校正形式映射到来源的选项标签上;它们不允许一般的字义校正或解释。 块序解析接受矩阵对象或阵列中的选项标签或整数代码、套装和字符串值的“null”。 共识解析接受一个言辞序言,然后才提出其他有效的答复。 例如,分析员接受“我的答案是强烈同意的”,但只确定了这一选择,而拒绝“Agree”和“Agree strong”两者仍然是可能的。 这些规则确定了允许的标签;它们不能保证每次较长的答复都表达明确的意图。 我们保留原始产出,记录每次正常化情况,并在覆盖面统计中保留无效和缺失的答复。

blocks.en: We analysed existing human datasets and collected new responses from language models. We did not recruit new human participants or obtain institutional ethics approval for this study. Appendix C describes the human data sources and their access conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们分析了现有的人类数据集,并从语言模型中收集了新的答复。 我们没有为这项研究招募新的人类参与者或获得机构道德认可。 附 录 C描述了人类数据来源及其获取条件.

blocks.en: The repository at https://github.com/artificial-societies/artificial-societies-benchmark provides the analysis code, task specifications, prompt templates, model settings and benchmark results. Readers can obtain the original human datasets through the providers described in Appendix C , subject to their access conditions.
